name: Ludwig Herzog von Mohn Nahe Liechtenstein
original_name: ルードヴィッヒ・ヘアツォーク・フォン・モーン・ナーエ・リヒテンシュタイン
source:
Star Sign: Scorpio
Club: Science Research

The oldest of three brothers in line to become a duke. His mother was born into royalty.
He was raised with the best education possible and entered the school to fulfill his ambition to shape the world as he wills.
